status: ASR-assisted annotation with automated QA complete; flagged intervals need human listening. No direct listening was performed by Codex.

methods.asr: Whisper large-v3 MLX 4-bit on Mac, plus faster-whisper base CPU/int8 cross-check
methods.reference: User-supplied prepared script; transcript follows acoustic-model wording when it conflicts, with names masked as [nama]
methods.alignment: Existing build_annotation.py; MMS CTC Viterbi; MAX_GAP=0.5s, MAX_UTT=15s; MPS CHUNK=16s to avoid convolution size limits
methods.spelling_review: Contextual review against script plus MMS CTC phrase scoring; numbers spelled out; English phrases marked code-switch
methods.events: Existing AST AudioSet model and thresholds, 2-second windows/1-second hop, batch size 2; no event candidates detected
methods.speaker: Existing WavLM x-vector cosine check using four >=2-second introduction utterances as reference; segments <0.5s unscored

technical_qa.segment_offsets: All five clips match the full recording exactly and are contiguous, with no gaps or overlaps (correlation 1.0).
technical_qa.edge_flag_note: Energy heuristic only; flags identify crop-edge review points and do not prove words were cut.
technical_qa.snr_note: Percentile-based estimate from existing QC script; not calibrated SNR.
